title: sharkd: Invalid request type should generate an error response
description:
If we send a request to sharkd in Console or Daemon Mode, sharkd
does not respond with a JSON message.  In Console mode, although
sharkd generates a log-type message it doesn't send a JSON response.

sharkd should respond with:
{"err":-32601, "errmsg":"The method %s is not supported"}

Closes #17247
